question: Do the fresh CarniDIET/CropPol local-unit designs contain enough multi-focal network structure for binary interaction rewiring to be structurally identifiable before partner identities are opened?
rationale: With one focal species per local unit, any shared partner observed in both units has the same sole focal edge, so binary within-network rewiring collapses and apparent interaction turnover is dominated by partner/species turnover.
pass_meaning: Necessary focal-side structural support only. PASS still does not authorize partner columns; partner-side shared-opportunity and estimator informativeness must later pass.
hold_meaning: Primary binary rewiring response is structurally unidentifiable under the frozen local-unit definition. Do not replace it with total interaction turnover or weighted diet change under the same confirmatory label.
